# authwise_guard_deprovisioning (Resource)

The service account a Guard tenant's deprovisioning sweep uses. A device a person enrolled keeps working after they lose Guard at the users-link home, because its token refreshes on the node's own identity. The sweep re-checks with this account and revokes each node whose owner no enrolment grant reaches any more. It never revokes on a failed read: that is a warning, readable on the `authwise_guard_deprovisioning` data source.

The account is a kit service account of the users-link tenant holding `tenant.viewer` there, for example an `authwise_service_account` and its `authwise_service_account_secret`. guard-control mints a token with it and reads the home once before storing it, and refuses a credential that cannot do both; nothing is stored then.

**The secret.** `client_secret_wo` is write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later): guard-control seals it, and it is not in the plan, not in state, and no API call returns it. Every apply that changes the account sends it again. To send a new secret alone, bump `client_secret_wo_version`.

Destroying the resource clears the account, and the sweep stops for the tenant. The guard-control install needs `sweep.sealKeyFile` and remote access mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The account the sweep re-checks the users-link home with: a service
# account of that tenant holding tenant.viewer there.
resource "authwise_guard_deprovisioning" "this" {
  tenant_id                = "gt-01"
  client_id                = authwise_service_account.guard_sweep.client_id
  client_secret_wo         = authwise_service_account_secret.guard_sweep.secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1
  token_url                = "https://id.example.authwise.io/oauth2/token"
  audience                 = "https://api.example.authwise.io"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `audience` (String) The audience the sweep asks its token for: the users-link home's admin API.
- `client_id` (String) The service account's client id.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The service account's client secret, write-only. Sent on create and on every update; never stored.
- `tenant_id` (String) The Guard tenant's id (`gt-…`), as awtenant reports it or `authwise_guard_tenants` lists it; the provider's `tenant_id` is not used. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `token_url` (String) The token endpoint the account's client credentials are exchanged at.

### Optional

- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this to send `client_secret_wo` again when nothing else about the account changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the Guard tenant's id. The secret cannot be recovered: nothing
# returns it. Bump client_secret_wo_version to send it again after importing.
terraform import authwise_guard_deprovisioning.this gt-01
```
